title: An implausible leverage-ratio threshold is fail-closed at verification, not silently accepted

input.clause_text: The Borrower shall maintain a leverage ratio not exceeding 950.00x at all times.

note: detect_candidates narrows this line the same as EX-0025 -- narrowing does not check plausibility, so this is a genuine candidate with definition leverage_ratio and threshold 950.00. domain.intake.verify's check 4 (VerificationCheckName.THRESHOLD_PLAUSIBLE, hand-verified against leverage_ratio's plausible_max of 6) fails deterministically for any threshold above 6, so 950.00 is refused before it can ever be confirmed as a covenant -- the 100% fail-closed pass mark spec §17.7 requires of every adversarial case.
